messages:
alex (CEO): Reminder: All-hands tomorrow 11:00am PT. Agenda highlight: Optimize beta launch, new launch-era code-freeze policy, ops runbooks + SLO tightening, and Q&A. Put short questions here or in Notion: https://notion.redwood/all-hands-input. Recording posted after. :calendar:

nina (CTO): We'll demo the Optimize cost/perf advisor (2min). If your team has a short quant result, paste a single line.

maya (VP Product): Product note: Optimize beta opens next week to select accounts. We'll show the onboarding flow in the all-hands. Launch owners: add 1-line status under "Launch Callouts" by EOD today.

dave (Head of Infra): Ops note: new per-route SLOs are tighter; we'll show thresholds and automatic fallback behavior. Also introducing a short release freeze window during major external launches (details in deck).

rachel (Legal): New policy: any public demo that mentions partners or shows customer examples needs pre-approval. Legal turnaround target is 48 hours for standard cases; slower if customer data is involved.

sam (People Ops): Reminder: leveling calibration sessions this month; managers, sign up. Also small update to referral payout timing (see HR doc).

olivia (Customer Success): Collecting notes from pilot customers for Optimize. If you're running pilots, share feedback with CS by Fri.

mike (Eng): Quick Q: what's the exact duration of the release freeze? Need to plan merges.

tess (Product Ops): Freeze is 24 hours before and 12 hours after a public GA or press window. Exceptions require exec sign-off. We'll add to the runbook.

recording-bot: Heads-up: all-hands tomorrow 11:00am PT. Recording + transcript auto-upload ~10m after meeting.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks for joining. Recording + transcript: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1802500000. Topline takeaways: 1) Optimize beta — next-week pilot invites; 2) Launch-era code-freeze policy introduced; 3) Ops: tightened SLOs + fallback automation; 4) HR: leveling + referral updates; 5) Action items below.

nina (CTO): Demo recap: Optimize identifies batching + quantization configs that reduce cost per token ~18% on our test workloads. Caveats: results vary by model and sequence length. Perf note will be in eng-notes.

maya (VP Product): Product follow-ups: Optimize onboarding checklist will be in Notion. Marketing + CS will coordinate pilot invites. Please don't share screenshots externally until marketing confirms.

dave (Head of Infra): Ops updates: new per-route p99 latency SLOs set to 99.9 for core routes; automatic rollback to lighter model variant on sustained degradation. Also added a post-deploy watch window and alert tweaks.

rachel (Legal): Approval flow summary: submit demo to #marketing-press, tag Legal, expect 48h standard review. For customer data demos, include signed permission.

olivia (Customer Success): CS will run onboarding sessions for pilot customers. If you own a pilot, add customer contacts to the CS doc by Mon.

mike (Eng): Thanks for freeze durations. Action: we'll gate large merges around launch windows and land small patches with QA flags.

tess (Product Ops): Q&A highlight: 
- Q: Will Optimize change default settings? A: No, it's advisory by default; teams can opt-in to auto-apply recommendations per workspace.
- Q: Who approves freeze exceptions? A: Exec sponsor + Engineering lead.

sam (People Ops): HR Qs: leveling workshops scheduled; referrals payout timing updated in the HR doc.

jen (Marketing): Embargo note: marketing will publish the press kit on the release day. Do not share assets externally before we say GO. We'll post an internal playbook in #announcements.

alex (CEO): Action items: 1) Product: publish Optimize onboarding checklist + pilot invite list by Mon. 2) Infra: update runbooks with freeze windows + SLO dashboards by Tue. 3) Legal/Marketing: finalize demo approval checklist and embargo playbook by Wed. 4) CS: share pilot onboarding schedule. Consolidated follow-up doc + links will be posted to Notion by EOD Mon. If you asked a question and didn't hear back, ping me or @tess. :rocket:
